name: Mount Gerizim

related_people.name: Jotham
related_people.role: shouted his parable of the trees from this mountain over Shechem

description: One of two mountains flanking Shechem from which Israel was to pronounce blessings (Gerizim) and curses (Ebal) upon entering Canaan (Deuteronomy 27:11-13); Jotham later shouted his fable warning against Abimelech's kingship from its slope (Judges 9:7).
family_friendly_summary: Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal are two mountains standing on either side of the town of Shechem. When Israel entered the promised land, half the tribes stood on Gerizim to announce God's blessings and half on Ebal for the warnings. Later, Jotham stood on Gerizim's slope to shout a warning about the cruel Abimelech.
